name: Infantry_Docs
author: Infantry AI
description: In-app docs lookup: the user-facing wiki pages ship inside the plugin jar and an agent reads one on demand (infantry docs list / infantry docs show <page>), so an agent in a user's install, with no repo checkout, can explain the app (for example the Usage page: worker limits and pacing). Nothing is loaded into any prompt; the pages cost tokens only when asked for. Daemon half only.

capabilities.description: The bundled docs pages: name and one-line title. docs.show gives the text.
One docs page's text (for example usage: why a worker is not running, meters, pacing). Unknown page = an error naming the available ones.

page.description: The page name from docs.list (case-insensitive, .md optional).
